step1_figure.description: The circuit implements a shunt-shunt feedback transimpedance amplifier consisting of a telescopic cascode operational amplifier (xm1-xm4) biased by a wide-swing cascode bias network (SUB_1), with a capacitive feedback network CF and NMOS reset switch xm5 across the input and output.

open_loop_voltage_gain.description: Open-loop voltage gain of the core telescopic cascode amplifier

equation.explanation: Calculates the intrinsic voltage gain of the cascode gain stage before applying negative feedback.
equation.assumptions: Transistors operate in saturation; G_M ≈ gm1 and R_Leq ≈ (gm2*ro2*ro1) || (gm3*ro3*ro4).

sky130_expected.calculation: With Ibias ≈ 20 uA, W/L = 10/1: gm1 = sqrt(2*un*Cox*(W/L)*Id) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 20u) ≈ 328 uS. ro = 1/(lambda*Id) = 1/(0.1*20u) = 500 kOhm. Rout,n ≈ gm2*ro2*ro1 = 328u * 500k * 500k ≈ 82 MOhm. For PMOS, gmp = sqrt(2 * 50u * 10 * 20u) ≈ 141 uS, Rout,p ≈ 141u * 500k * 500k ≈ 35 MOhm. Ro = Rout,n || Rout,p ≈ 24.5 MOhm. A_v ≈ 328uS * 24.5MOhm ≈ 8000 V/V ≈ 78 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Telescopic cascode topology in 180nm CMOS provides DC voltage gains typically between 70 dB and 85 dB.

closed_loop_transimpedance_gain.description: Closed-loop transimpedance gain at low-to-midband frequency

equation.formula: A_CL = v_o / i_s = A_OL / (1 + A_OL * beta) ≈ 1 / beta
equation.explanation: Shunt-shunt feedback sets the transimpedance gain to the inverse of the feedback network admittance.

sky130_expected.calculation: For capacitive feedback CF = 10 fF at f = 100 kHz: |Z_F| = 1/(2*pi*f*CF) = 1/(2*pi*1e5*1e-14) ≈ 159 MOhm (164 dB ohm). With reset resistance R_on or large feedback impedance, midband transimpedance tracks |Z_F|.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by feedback capacitance CF = 10 fF.

closed_loop_input_impedance.description: Closed-loop input impedance looking into the inverting node

equation.explanation: Shunt feedback at the input decreases the input impedance by the loop gain factor (1 + T).
equation.assumptions: Miller effect/feedback lowers effective input impedance.

sky130_expected.calculation: Looking into the feedback node with CF = 10 fF and Miller multiplication (1 + |Av|): C_in,eff ≈ CF * (1 + |Av|) ≈ 10 fF * 8000 ≈ 80 pF. At 100 kHz, |Z_in| ≈ 1/(2*pi*1e5*80e-12) ≈ 20 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Shunt feedback reduces the effective node impedance by the loop gain.

closed_loop_output_impedance.description: Closed-loop output impedance of the transimpedance amplifier

equation.explanation: Shunt sampling at the output reduces output impedance by the factor (1 + A_OL * beta).

sky130_expected.calculation: Open loop output resistance Ro ≈ 25 MOhm. With feedback loop factor (1 + T) ≈ 100 to 1000 at intermediate frequencies, Rof reduces to ~25 kOhm to 250 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Shunt-shunt topology strongly reduces the open-loop output impedance.

transient_integration_rate.description: Integration slew rate dVout/dt for a constant input current

equation.explanation: In an ideal charge integrator / transimpedance amplifier with capacitive feedback, input current is integrated onto CF.
equation.assumptions: Reset switch is open and amplifier virtual ground holds.

sky130_expected.calculation: dV_out/dt = -10 pA / 10 fF = -1.0 * 10^-11 A / 1.0 * 10^-14 F = -1000 V/s = -0.001 V/us = -1 mV/us. Over Baker's 30 us transient simulation: Delta V_out = -1 mV/us * 30 us = -30 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Iin = 10 pA charging CF = 10 fF creates a linear ramp of -1 mV/us.

dc_bias_power_dissipation.description: Total quiescent power dissipation of amplifier and cascode bias block

equation.explanation: Total static DC power drawn from the 1.8V power supply.
equation.assumptions: Quiescent state with zero dynamic reset switching.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_bias branch ≈ 20 uA * ~6 branches in SUB_1 plus main cascode branch ≈ 140 uA. Total power = 1.8 V * 140 uA ≈ 250 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Beta-multiplier based wide-swing cascode bias generator dissipates around 100-300 uW in 180nm CMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive testbench measuring DC operating point, cascode voltage gain, transimpedance frequency response, input/output impedance, and transient integration ramp matching Baker's simulation settings.
